notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34611031/6798ca28d57fa25eca6969b85707efba8d93a7ef.jpg[/img]

We are releasing another patch today.

- When you press fence stones after you put them in the fence, your fence key count was decreasing. Now fixed.
- Added a 'Keybinds' button in 'In-Game Menu' to show you every key in the game.
- You can now collect water everywhere in the river.
- Lever in the first cave was moving before it was placed. Now fixed.
- You can now close the map with Escape button.
- 'Low Health' indicator on the screen is now shown when health is below %50. Before it was below %100.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34611031/4927ba43091b4f5ee1f125b659afd98d0f9ebf43.jpg[/img]


We're releasing a patch that covers the problems that happen in the first day.


- Graphic changes now affect more.
- Health loss over time has been reduced.
- New game option and credits added.
- Minor UI changes and bug fixes.
- Camp fire issue has been fixed. A little warning has been added regarding to wood count.
- The ladder disappearance in the first cave has been fixed.


Clarification Note: The game is linear with the story. You need to progress through the story to discover and puzzle things together. You have your collected notes and inventory when you get the map.


Edit: Additional fixes.
